# All 62 commands

Every command is typed after the menu skill in Claude Code and Cowork, `/fundadmin:fund <command> <args>`, or called as its own skill, `/fundadmin:fund-<command> <args>`. Codex names the skill: `$fund-<command> <args>`. With the [plain-skills install](/guide/install#plain-skills-no-plugin-system) drop the `fundadmin:` prefix.
